column1: # cqrs-htmx re-export baseline — the closed set of files holding cross-package aliases.
# Frozen on 2026-11-06: 47 files, 413 alias declarations across the workspace.
# (The per-row counts below are authoritative; this header is a convenience sum and
#  was corrected from 418 to 413 on 2026-11-06 — the scanner is the only source.)
#   * alias counts may SHRINK freely (the gate only fails on growth);
#   * a row may be DELETED when its file is deleted at the v5 cut;
#   * a row may be ADDED only by amending ADR-0062 — the gate refuses an
#     unclassified alias file, and refusing is the point;
#   * bump this file in the SAME commit as the code change that moves a count.
#   reexport                  a compatibility layer: exported aliases must be
#                             // Deprecated: and name their target package
#   exempt:internal           declaring package or alias target is under
#                             internal/, so consumers cannot import it
#   exempt:domain-vocabulary  the declaring package owns the constructors and
#                             parsers for the type; the alias spells a domain
#                             name, not a second import path
#   exempt:pending            a candidate re-export layer whose disposition is
#                             decided in the wave named in the note; frozen in
